'''''Ferraria crispa''''' is a species of [[monocotyledon]]ous [[flowering plant]] in the [[Family (taxonomy)|family]] [[Iridaceae]]. It is native to [[South Africa]].<ref>[https://apps.kew.org/wcsp/namedetail.do?name_id=328051 Kew World Checklist of Selected Plant Families]</ref>

In [[Australia]] it is commonly referred to as '''black flag'''.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.weeds.org.au/cgi-bin/weedident.cgi?tpl=plant.tpl&ibra=all&card=E05 |title=Weeds Australia - Black Flag |accessdate=May 3, 2010 |url-status=dead |archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20101203114503/http://weeds.org.au/cgi-bin/weedident.cgi?tpl=plant.tpl&ibra=all&card=E05 |archivedate=December 3, 2010 }}</ref> It is also known as '''starfish lily'''.<ref>{{cite web|title=Plant Profile: Ferraria crispa - Starfish Lily |url=http://www.ausgardener.com.au/plant-care/Ferraria-crispa.html |publisher=Australian Gardener Plant Nursery |accessdate=4 September 2012 |url-status=dead |archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20120322093222/http://www.ausgardener.com.au/plant-care/Ferraria-crispa.html |archivedate=22 March 2012 }}</ref>
